commit.subject: LU-10026 csdc: add ll_compr_hdr structure
commit.message:
LU-10026 csdc: add ll_compr_hdr structure

It is an important structure for CSDC feature. Will be used
in the next patches.

Also adds LL_COMPR_TYPE_UNCHANGED enum value (used to signal that
the compression type should not be changed on update) and the
LL_LZ4FAST_MAX_LEVEL define (maximum level for the LZ4FAST algorithm).

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
Signed-off-by: Artem Blagodarenko <ablagodarenko@ddn.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>
